images.note: Hero beat (hero of the common man / King Andrew). Primary: Asher B. Durand engraving, June 1828 — contemporary, election-year. Alt: LOC daguerreotype c.1844-45 — contemporary, Jackson in his last year.
images.title: General Andrew Jackson — engraving, June 1828

images.note: Corrupt-bargain beat (Clay the kingmaker, Secretary of State payoff). Primary: Clevenger marble bust 1837, from life — contemporary. Alt: LOC portrait dated 1850-52 — late-life, contemporary.
images.title: Henry Clay — marble bust, 1837

images.note: 1828 mudslinging beat (Rachel attacked as adulteress, died Dec 1828, Jackson blamed the papers). LOC dates this print c.1883 — later reproduction of the contemporary Earl portrait; no second-institution scan found at bar.
images.title: Mrs. Andrew Jackson (Rachel)

images.note: Inauguration-mob beat (muddy boots, broken furniture; franchise walking through the door). 1841 print of the 1829 inaugural reception — later depiction, 12 years after the event; no second-institution scan found at bar.
images.title: President's Levee, or all Creation going to the White House
